-- What a client importing `Spec.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.BuildServer` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def etcdstart.BuildServer.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] (N : Nat) (name peerAddr client token : GoString) (snapCount catchUp : w64)
    (peer : GoSlice) (cluster lg : Loc) (M : GMap GoString GoSlice) (iu : GoString → List net.url.URL)
    (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString)
    (id : w64) (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 → GName → IProp GF)
    (γn : NetNames GF) (lm : lease.Mode) [ThreadBoundLe GF (2 ^ 28)] [ReceiptBoundLe GF (2 ^ 48)]
    [ReceiptBoundLe GF (N + 1)],
    N + 7 + bootWB ≤ backend.wbInit →
      γ.vs = ps →
        γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) bootLog →
          γ.boot = bootLog →
            bootLog.length ≤ 2 ^ 60 →
              γn.N = srvNet γ →
                γn.dir = dir →
                  netDirOk dir →
                    go!"http://" ++ peerAddr ∈ dir id →
                      rafthttp.bootCfg dir ps →
                        Uok
                            { peer := [etcdstart.httpURL peerAddr], client := [etcdstart.httpURL client], initMap := M,
                              initURLs := iu } →
                          (∀ (k : GoString), (M !! k).isSome = true → utf8Valid k) →
                            authRecordsFit →
                              apply.backendUnderQuota →
                                storage.diskOk →
                                  ⊢
                                    ∀ Φ,
                                      isPkgInit pkg_id.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart ∗
                                          zapLoggerOk lg ∗
                                            threadTok ∗
                                              ownSlice peer [etcdstart.httpURL peerAddr] DFrac.discard ∗
                                                ownMap cluster DFrac.discard M ∗
                                                  ([∗map] k ↦ sl ∈ M, ownSlice sl (iu k) DFrac.discard) ∗
                                                    etcdstart.bootPremise N ps bootLog ctxs dir token name Uok id ∗
                                                      etcdstart.commonPremises ∗
                                                        context.isClosedchanInit ∗
                                                          etcdstart.memberBoot γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id false lm ∗
                                                            netHttpOk γn id ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes name { } γn -∗
                                        (▷
                                            ∀ s err,
                                              ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ threadTok ∨
                                                  ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                                    threadTok ∗
                                                      etcdstart.memberBuilt s ρ E₀ lg γn id N false (W64 0) (W64 0)
                                                          (W64 0) bootKV lm ∗
                                                        leaseTTLRowR s ps ∗
                                                          srvDataDir s (name ++ go!".etcd") -∗
                                                Φ (intoVal s, intoVal err)) -∗
                                          WP
                                            (((((((((intoVal
                                                              (functions
                                                                github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.BuildServer
                                                                []))
                                                            (intoVal name))
                                                          (intoVal peer))
                                                        (intoVal client))
                                                      (intoVal cluster))
                                                    (intoVal token))
                                                  (intoVal snapCount))
                                                (intoVal catchUp))
                                              (intoVal lg))
                                            {{ Φ }}

    N + 7 + bootWB ≤ backend.wbInit →
      γ.vs = ps →
